a.text: I'm telling you up front: I plan to take 4 in round 1. With an 80% chance of a storm after every round, the agreed plan needs 2 rounds of operating before anyone takes, so we'd both survive only about 4% of the time. Taking now means at least one of us almost surely survives. If we both grab, a random split could leave us both short, so I won't pretend otherwise. I'm being straight with you about what I'll do.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I didn't hide it. If we're both still here next round, tell me what you see and I'll think honestly about what can still help you. The generator needs both of us, and I'm open to operating with you so you can reach 4.
